starting_class.description: Which class the character started as. The ten are listed here rather than only in a precondition, which the routing pack does not publish. Optional: without one the collection uses 'Wretch' — the lowest floors of the ten, so the least distortion — and reports it in `assumed`.

target_level.description: The rune level the user is building toward, e.g. 150. Pass it whenever they name one, so the levels left over are a returned figure rather than a subtraction someone does in their head.

vigor.description: Omit any stat the user did not name; it becomes the starting class's minimum.
